name: Dragonfly
description: A free, open-source REST API client that runs inside VS Code. Build and send requests, discover Express and Next.js routes in your workspace, import Postman/OpenAPI/cURL, and manage collections and environments without leaving your editor.
capabilities: Build and send HTTP requests (method, URL, params, headers, body, auth) from the VS Code sidebar
Discover Express and Next.js routes (App Router and Pages Router) by scanning your workspace
Import Postman collections, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, and cURL commands
Manage collections and environments with {{variable}} substitution
Copy any request as cURL, Node.js, Python, Go, PHP, Java, or Rust
Keep collections, history, and secrets local to VS Code, with no account and no telemetry
pricing: Free. MIT licensed, no paid tier.
